item.title: Florence Nightingale (1820–1910) — Defying Victorian Gentry, Scutari's Open Sewers, the Polar-Area Coxcomb Diagram, and Four Decades Running Empire Health From Bed
item.description: Behind Victorian Britain's sentimental portrait of 'The Lady with the Lamp' stood one of the nineteenth century's most formidable applied statisticians, sanitary engineers, and back-channel political strategists. From secret dawn mathematics lessons at Embley Park and a fourteen-year war against upper-class domestic confinement to confronting a 42.7 percent hospital mortality crisis atop Scutari's blocked cesspools, Florence Nightingale teamed with Chief Statistician William Farr to forge the Polar-Area Coxcomb diagram—proving visually that preventable zymotic disease, not Russian bullets, was slaughtering British troops. Shutting out polite society from her Mayfair sickbed on South Street, she commanded Viceroys of India, Cabinet ministers, and global pavilion hospital architects across fourteen thousand razor-sharp letters, revolutionizing epidemiology, nursing, and imperial public health.

item.title: Crossing the Rare-Disease Valley of Death: The 1983 Orphan Drug Act, Priority Review Vouchers, AAV Safety Reckonings, n-Lorem & The Economics of Curing Ultra-Rare Channelopathies — One-Ångström walks inside ABE8e (PDB 6VPC), Prime Editor elongation complex (PDB 8WUV), and human NaV1.1/beta4 (PDB 7DTD); ultra-rare break-even rNPV & PRV sign-flip math + 1-to-3-quadrillion AAV hepatocyte MOI physics; Glybera, bluebird bio, Pfizer/Takeda/Vertex AAV exits, AT132 ASPIRO (NCT03199469), n-Lorem, NIH BGTC, FDA Platform Designation, ETX101 (NCT05419492) & Baby KJ 2025
item.description: Complete five-act One-Ångström-Tall Man biophysical, clinical, economic, and policy treatise confronting the Rare-Disease Valley of Death for ultra-rare channelopathies. Contrasts 1-Ångström molecular readiness against commercial collapses (uniQure Glybera 1-patient withdrawal, bluebird bio 3 FDA approvals yet >99% equity collapse to May 2025 Carlyle/SK Capital USD 45M buyout, and 2023-2025 Takeda/Pfizer Beqvez/Vertex/Novartis AAV pullbacks). Walks at 1 Å inside verified RCSB PDBs 6VPC (ABE8e TadA-8e Zn2+/Glu59/Val106/Asn108/Arg111/8AZ + SpCas9 D10A Ala207), 8WUV (2024 Prime Editor SpCas9 H840A + M-MLV RT YVDD Asp224/Asp225 + 2DA16-U109 Watson-Crick pairing showing 99% macromolecular invariance underpinning FDA Platform Technology Designation), and 7DTD (human NaV1.1/beta4 Cys919-Cys58, IFM latch Phe1499, pore Phe1774/9Z9 illustrating the 6.0-kb single-AAV limit, >1,800 private Dravet mutations, and Encoded Therapeutics' mutation-agnostic ETX101 NCT05419492). Includes two explicit spoken Calculation Pauses (ultra-rare break-even net/list price, risk-adjusted NPV = -USD 15.87M flipped to +USD 11.29M/+USD 16.73M by a USD 125M-150M PRV; and 10 kg infant systemic AAV vector load of 1-3 quadrillion vg reaching 60,000 vg / 120,000 capsids per hepatocyte at 3x10^14 vg/kg vs 100-fold reduction via engineered capsids). Covers the 1983 Orphan Drug Act, RPD PRVs (2024-2026 USD 150M-210M sales and Feb 3, 2026 reauthorization through Sept 30, 2029), AT132 ASPIRO cholestatic hepatotoxicity (NCT03199469, Karolczak JCI 2023), Zolgensma TMA/DRG/GLI1 safety, Stanley Crooke's n-Lorem Foundation (Cousin Med 2026), NIH AMP BGTC, FDA May 2024 Platform Technology Designation, and the landmark May 2025 CHOP/Penn/IGI/Aldevron/Acuitas Baby KJ 6-month LNP-ABE blueprint (Musunuru & Ahrens-Nicklas, NEJM 2025), closing with the next decisive extra-hepatic syncytial delivery shootout and Umbrella-CHAN platform trial roadmap.

item.title: Salt, Voltage, and the Silent Anion Gate: Endocrine Hypertension & Anion-Exchanger Channelopathies (KCNJ5, CLCN2, CACNA1D, Pendred & Congenital Chloride Diarrhea) — One-Ångström walks inside GIRK2/KCNJ5 (4KFM), human ClC-2 + AK-42 (8GQU), CaV1.3 EEEE/Gly403 (7UHG), and Pendrin (7WL7); adrenal GHK depolarization & ARR/AVS physics; mutant-selective macrolides, ABE9/PEmax & SLC26A4 ASO blueprints; and the USD 1.8 billion aldosterone synthase biotech saga (osilodrostat, baxdrostat, lorundrostat)
item.description: Wave 11 Channelopathies Episode CHAN_15 (Ep 2681): Five-act One-Ångström-Tall Man medical, biophysical, base-editing, and biotech-history treatise covering endocrine hypertension channelopathies (KCNJ5/GIRK4 FH-III vs. somatic APA & G151E cell-death paradox; CLCN2 GoF FH-II vs. recessive CC2L leukoencephalopathy/chorioretinopathy/azoospermia; CACNA1D GoF PASNA vs. recessive exon-8B SANDD at Gly403) and sister SLC26 epithelial anion exchangers (SLC26A4 Pendred syndrome EVA/goiter/perchlorate discharge & SLC26A3 Congenital Chloride Diarrhea fecal Cl- > 90 mM with metabolic alkalosis). Anchored to verified RCSB PDB geometries 4KFM, 8GQU, 7UHG, and 7WL7; includes two spoken calculation pauses (zona glomerulosa GHK depolarization shifts; ARR/AVS lateralization, CLD stool Cl- flux, and empirical Phase 3 BaxHTN/Launch-HTN BP reductions); covers mutant-selective macrolides (MAPA), AK-42, codon-exact ABE9/PEmax/SLC26A4 c.919-2A>G ASO strategies, and the 20-year CYP11B2 vs. CYP11B1 ASI biotech history (Novartis/Recordati USD 390 million osilodrostat, CinCor/AstraZeneca USD 1.8 billion baxdrostat, Mineralys USD 192 million IPO lorundrostat).

item.title: Cilia, Slit Diaphragms, and Acidic Endosomes: PKD2 ADPKD, TRPC6 Podocyte FSGS & CLCN5 Dent Disease 1 — Mayo htTKV & PKD1 6-pseudogene traps, steroid-resistant TRPC6 FSGS & the calcineurin-synaptopodin paradox, Dent 1 CLCN5 vs. OCRL LMW proteinuria, 1-Å cryo-EM walks inside PKD2 (5T4D), TRPC6+AM-0883 (6UZ8) & CLC-7/OSTM1 (7JM7, Glu247=ClC-5 Glu211), endosomal V-ATPase stall & TEMPO/REPRISE economics, Otsuka Jynarque REMS, Novartis USD 1.7B Regulus farabursen buyout, Boehringer BI 764198 Lancet FSGS readout, and base/prime/CRISPRa editing across the glomerular filtration barrier
item.description: Wave 11 Channelopathies Episode CHAN_16 (Ep 2682): Five-act One-Ångström-Tall Man medical, structural-biophysics, gene-editing, and biotech-history treatise uniting three specialized renal subcellular microdomains: (1) Primary-cilium PKD2 (TRPP2) / PKD1 ADPKD (Mayo Imaging Classification 1A-1E, 8-11% intracranial berry aneurysm MRA screening, PKD1 exons 1-33 6-pseudogene LR-PCR trap, Cornec-Le Gall median ESRD ages 55.6/67.9/79.7 yr, Outeda 2026 D511V VSD destabilization & Tian 2026 RASSF4 potentiation); (2) Podocyte slit-diaphragm dominant GoF TRPC6 FSGS (P112Q, M132T, R895C, E897K; steroid resistance & calcineurin-synaptopodin-cathepsin-L paradox; up to 14% monogenic adult FSGS); and (3) Proximal-tubule apical endosomal CLCN5 Dent Disease 1 vs. OCRL Dent Disease 2 (dipstick-albumin discordance, 100x-1000x urine beta-2-microglobulin/RBP, hypercalciuria, medullary nephrocalcinosis, rickets, 30-80% ESRD ages 30-50). Grounded in three verified RCSB PDB cryo-EM structures with 40+ measured interatomic distances: 5T4D (3.0 Å human PKD2 nanodisc: LGD selectivity filter Asp643-Arg638 2.67 Å, Gly642-Ile639 2.91 Å, S6 Leu677 hydrophobic gate 3.41 Å), 6UZ8 (2.84 Å human TRPC6 + agonist AM-0883 R0D + lipid SBM: FSGS brake contacts Arg895-Glu897 2.91 Å, Met132-Lys864 2.92 Å, Pro112-Glu900 3.47 Å, R0D-Trp680 3.32 Å, R0D-SBM lipid kiss 3.72 Å), and 7JM7 (2.82 Å human CLC-7/OSTM1 homolog of ClC-5: gating glutamate Glu247 [= ClC-5 Glu211] 2.98 Å from S_ext CL904, S_cen CL903-Tyr602 2.29 Å, S_int CL905-Gly203 2.77 Å, CBS ATP-Lys785 1.69 Å, ATP-Mg 1.96 Å, Mg-Glu95 2.43 Å, interfacial PI(3)P 0J1-Lys285 2.17 Å). Includes two fully worked spoken Calculation Pauses (300-nm endosome V-ATPase 318-ms stall at 3,177 H+ / +180 mV vs. 357,571 H+ buffered requirement and ClC-5 +42.0 mM luminal Cl- concentration; Mayo Class 1D htTKV doubling times & REPRISE 6.77 dialysis-free years vs. USD 280,000/yr Jynarque economics), full biotech histories (Otsuka tolvaptan TEMPO 3:4 / 2013 CRL / REPRISE / 2018 REMS; Regulus RGLS4326 clinical hold -> farabursen RGLS8429 Phase 1b 0.05% htTKV arrest -> Novartis 2025 USD 800M upfront / USD 1.7B CVR acquisition; Vertex VX-407 AGLOW; Boehringer Ingelheim BI 764198 COVID-19 ARDS Thorax 2023 failure -> Lancet 2026 FSGS 35% vs 7.1% / 44% at 20 mg & Phase 3 NCT07220083), ABE8e/CBE/iSTOP/Prime/CRISPRa strategies across the 6-8 nm glomerular filtration barrier, textbook myth debunking (Delling & Clapham 2016 cilia Ca2+, immune-FSGS dogma, Jentsch 2010 ClC-5 E211A uncoupling), and a decisive two-arm cryo-EM + porcine/NHP renal-delivery experiment.

item.title: Scramblase-Channels, Mg2+/H+ & Retinal Synaptic Channelopathies — One-Ångström atomic walks inside TMEM16F (6QP6), TRPM7/TRPM6 chanzyme (5ZX5), TRPV6 (6BO8), poreless proton channel mHv1cc/HVCN1 (3WKV, -4 mouse-to-human offset) & human P2X3 + ATP (5SVK); phagocyte NOX2 31-ms stall & TRPM6 oral paracellular bypass calculations; NIH NIAID MAGT1 mRNA/CRISPR-AAV HSPC editing, split-intein dual-AAV CACNA1F/TRPM1 CSNB & the USD 3.25B Merck gefapixant vs. GSK Bellus camlipixant July 2026 reckoning
item.description: Wave 11 Episode CHAN_20 (Ep 2686): Complete five-act One-Ångström-Tall Man medical, biophysical, gene-editing, and biotech-history treatise covering boundary-crossing channelopathies: ANO6/TMEM16F Scott Syndrome (normal PT/aPTT/vWF/CBC/LTA failing only prothrombin consumption and Annexin-V PS exposure; Weiss 1979 -> Suzuki & Nagata Nature 2010; plus PIEZO1-TMEM16F xerocytosis, Kupffer-cell LLO repair, 16F.386.5 tumor reprogramming, and muscle twin ANO5/TMEM16E LGMDR12/MMD3 & GDD), TRPM6 Hypomagnesemia with Secondary Hypocalcemia (refractory hypocalcemic seizures at serum Mg2+ 0.20 mmol/L; PTH collapse and lifesaving high-dose oral paracellular Mg2+ bypass), MAGT1 XMEN disease (chronic EBV viremia, CD4 lymphopenia, B-cell lymphoma; shift from Mg2+ channel hypothesis & NCT02496676 to ER STT3B-OST N-glycosylation of NKG2D; NIH NIAID Lenardo/Malech ex-vivo MAGT1 mRNA electroporation & >60% CRISPR/Cas9-AAV6 endogenous-locus HSPC editing), TRPV6-pathies (self-healing Transient Neonatal Hyperparathyroidism & early-onset non-alcoholic chronic pancreatitis), HVCN1 poreless voltage-gated proton channel in phagocyte NOX2 charge compensation, retinal synaptic channelopathies with electronegative Schubert-Bornschein ERG (presynaptic CACNA1F CaV1.4 incomplete iCSNB + congenital pRNFL thinning vs. postsynaptic TRPM1 ON-bipolar complete cCSNB, adult MAR autoimmunity & Appaloosa LP horses), and the USD 3.25 billion P2X3 chronic-cough selectivity drama (Merck Afferent USD 1.25B gefapixant P2X2/3 dysgeusia FDA CRLs vs. GSK USD 2.0B Bellus Health camlipixant buyout and July 17, 2026 CALM-1/CALM-2 discontinuation). Walks physically at 1 Å inside verified RCSB PDBs 6QP6, 5ZX5, 6BO8, 3WKV (explicit -4 mouse-to-human offset), and 5SVK with >40 verbatim .cif distances and two spoken step-by-step calculation pauses.

item.title: Storms Across the Cortex, Stumbles in the Cerebellum, and the Startle That Stops Breath: FHM1/FHM2, Episodic Ataxias & Hereditary Hyperekplexia — One-Ångström cryo-EM/X-ray walks inside human P/Q-type CaV2.1 (8X90), full-length Shaker Kv1.2 (3LUT), and open α1 Glycine Receptor (6PM6), Ca²⁺ fourth-power cooperativity & 3 mm/min CSD math, 4-AP/EAT-2-TREAT, Vigevano maneuver, niflumic acid Kv1.1 activation, and Phase 3 N-acetyl-L-leucine (NCT07221292)
item.description: Wave 10 Channelopathies Episode 9 (Ep 2669 / CHAN_09): Complete 5-act One-Ångström-Tall Man medical and biophysical treatise uniting Familial Hemiplegic Migraine (FHM1 CACNA1A GoF R192Q/S218L/T666M, FHM2 ATP1A2 glial Na+/K+-ATPase LoF, FHM3 SCN1A GoF), Episodic Ataxias (EA1 KCNA1 Kv1.1 LoF with interictal myokymia vs. EA2 CACNA1A LoF with downbeat nystagmus and SCA6 exon-47 polyQ / bicistronic alpha1ACT), and Hereditary Hyperekplexia (GLRA1/GLRB/SLC6A5 stiff-baby startle apnea rescued by Vigevano maneuver & clonazepam). Anchored to direct coordinate measurements from RCSB PDB 8X90 (2.95 Å human CaV2.1 with CA2604, PS1, PT5 PIP2, and -1 DII offset at THR665 = canonical Thr666), 3LUT (2.9 Å full-length Shaker Kv1.2-Kvbeta2 with K500-K504, TVGYG, ARG294, S6 PVP +2 offset vs Kv1.1 V408A, and NAP368), and 6PM6 (2.9 Å open alpha1 GlyR bound to GLY504 with transparent +16 zebrafish-to-mature-human and +28 precursor HGVS numbering map: ARG287 = mature Arg271 19'-Arg, LEU277 = mature Leu261 9'-Leu, PRO266 = mature Pro250 -2'). Includes two spoken calculation pauses (presynaptic Ca2+ n=4 cooperativity 1.25^4 = 2.44x and 3 mm/min CSD 20-30 min occipital-to-motor march vs embolic stroke), RCT evidence (Strupp 2011, EAT-2-TREAT 2021), Servettini PNAS 2023 NFA Kv1.1 activation, Aldhilan 2022 & Dolu 2024 hyperekplexia cohorts, and verified ClinicalTrials.gov anchors (NCT07221292, NCT00266760, NCT01470729, NCT00358839, NCT00687947, NCT00257985, NCT00541736, NCT05687474).

item.title: When the Folding Clock Breaks: Cystic Fibrosis (CFTR Classes I-VI), Trikafta & Alyftrek Rescue, and the Modulator-Ineligible 10% Frontier — One-Ångström cryo-EM walks inside human CFTR (5UAK apo, 6MSM ATP-dimerized, 8EIQ ΔF508 bound to tezacaftor CV6, elexacaftor WJX & ivacaftor VX7), sweat-duct vs. airway Cl-/HCO3- & NPD physics, ΔΔG folding math, SKYLINE/RIDGELINE Alyftrek, and Class I mRNA/AAV/ACE-tRNA/prime editing
item.description: Wave 10 Channelopathies Episode 11 (Ep 2671 / CHAN_11): Five-act One-Ångström-Tall Man medical and biophysical treatise on Cystic Fibrosis (CFTR / ABCC7 Classes I-VI), contrasting severe newborn F508del/F508del meconium ileus (sweat Cl- 104 mmol/L), adult R117H-5T CBAVD/recurrent pancreatitis (sweat Cl- 42 mmol/L), and modulator-ineligible Class I G542X/W1282X; tracing Dorothy Andersen (1938), Paul di Sant'Agnese (1953), Gibson & Cooke (1959), Paul Quinton (1983), Tsui/Riordan/Collins (1989), Beekman rectal organoid FIS (2013), and Jue Chen's human CFTR cryo-EM trilogy (PDB 5UAK, 6MSM, 8EIQ with CV6 tezacaftor, WJX elexacaftor, VX7 ivacaftor); featuring two spoken calculation pauses (sweat-duct vs. airway Cl-/HCO3- polarity, Henderson-Hasselbalch ASL pH 7.20->6.62 & NPD Wilschanski index; Boltzmann ddG folding synergy & multiplicative N_surf x P_o rescue math), verified Phase 3 evidence (Ramsey 2011, Wainwright 2015, Middleton 2019, Heijerman 2019, Mall 2022, Burgel 2024, SKYLINE 102/103 & RIDGELINE 2025), One Medicine CF pig/ferret proofs, and verified Class I 10% frontier trials (NCT05668741 VX-522, NCT06237335 RCT2100, NCT05248230 4D-710, NCT06526923 SP-101, NCT06515002/NCT06962852 BI 3720931, Ahern ACE-tRNAs, Bulcaen 2024 prime editing).

item.title: Salt, Sugar, and One Broken Atom: Renal Tubular (Bartter, Gitelman, EAST/SeSAME, PHA1) & Endocrine K_ATP Neonatal Diabetes / DEND Channelopathies — Genetic lifelong furosemide vs. thiazide (+8 mV TAL paracellular Ca2+ physics, urine Cl-/Ca2+/Cr triage & MLPA), EAST/SeSAME Kir4.1 vs. Kir5.1, PHA1 vs. Liddle ENaC mirrors, One-Ångström cryo-EM walks inside human NCC (8FHT, 8VPN + indapamide/WNK-SPAK) and pancreatic K_ATP (6BAA + glibenclamide, 6C3O + MgADP), and high-dose oral sulfonylurea transfer freeing 93% of KCNJ11 children from insulin needles
item.description: Wave 10 Channelopathies Episode 12 (Ep 2672): Five-act One-Ångström-Tall Man medical and biophysical treatise uniting Renal Tubular Channelopathies (Antenatal/Classic Bartter Types I–V [SLC12A1/NKCC2, KCNJ1/ROMK transient neonatal hyperkalemia, CLCNKB, BSND/Barttin deafness, MAGED2], Gitelman Syndrome [SLC12A3/NCC, 6% Alu MLPA rearrangements, Gordon/FHHt WNK-SPAK mirror], EAST/SeSAME [KCNJ10/Kir4.1 vs. KCNJ16/Kir5.1 acidosis], and Systemic PHA1B [SCNN1A/B/G ENaC LoF mirror of Liddle Syndrome]) with the Endocrine K_ATP Mirror (KCNJ11/ABCC8 GoF Permanent Neonatal Diabetes & iDEND/DEND Syndrome vs. Congenital Hyperinsulinism). Grounded in four verified RCSB PDB cryo-EM structures (8FHT [3.02 Å human NCC + Na+/Cl-], 8VPN [2.7 Å phosphorylated human NCC + indapamide BL1 + WNK-SPAK TPO55/TPO60/SEP73 + CTD ATP, -1 isoform numbering offset], 6BAA [3.63 Å Kir6.2/SUR1 K_ATP + ATP + glibenclamide GBM at ARG1246 2.80 Å], and 6C3O [3.9 Å human K_ATP quatrefoil + K+ TIGFG + SUR1 MgADP 1.89 Å / MgATP 1.98 Å]), two spoken calculation pauses (+8 mV lumen-positive TAL paracellular divalent Boltzmann factor & uCa/uCr + uCl- differential; p.Arg201His 30x IC50(ATP) shift locking beta-cell V_m at -80.7 mV and 0.5-1.5 mg/kg/day glibenclamide transfer physics with zero severe hypoglycemia), all 15 dossier PMIDs / 10 PMCIDs, and all 14 verified ClinicalTrials.gov NCT trials (NCT02624817 10-year 93% durable insulin independence, NCT00334711, NCT02624830, NCT05751525, NCT02921906, NCT00321321, NCT06065852, NCT03847571, NCT04995627, NCT01146197, NCT00822107, NCT00276289, NCT02297048, NCT02035046).

item.title: Beyond Action Potentials: Immune, Auditory, Retinal & Mechanosensitive Rare Channelopathies — One-Ångström cryo-EM & X-ray walks inside hexameric Orai (4HKR), Connexin-26 (2ZW3), native TMC-1 (7USW), pentameric BEST1 (6N26), cone CNGA3/CNGB3-cGMP (8EV8), and 114-TM PIEZO2 (6KG7), ~20 fS CRAC vs. +80 mV endocochlear physics, urgent HSCT, subretinal AAV-CNGA3/CNGB3, intracochlear AAV-GJB2/TMC1, and zegocractin
item.description: Wave 10 Channelopathies Episode 13 (Ep 2673): Five-act One-Ångström-Tall Man medical and biophysical treatise on immune, auditory, retinal, and mechanosensitive rare channelopathies — contrasting ORAI1 p.Arg91Trp / STIM1 LoF T+B+NK+ CRAC SCID (normal flow cytometry & TRECs, hypotonia, anhidrosis, amelogenesis imperfecta; cured immunologically by HSCT while non-hematopoietic organs persist) against dominant STIM1 p.Arg304Trp / ORAI1 GoF Stormorken Syndrome & Tubular Aggregate Myopathy; GJB2 (Cx26 c.35delG, p.Met34Thr, p.Val37Ile) cochlear K+ recycling deafness against TMC1 (DFNB7/11 & DFNA36) hair-cell MET pore deafness; CNGA3/CNGB3 achromatopsia (flat photopic ERG, normal scotopic rod ERG) against BEST1 Best vitelliform macular dystrophy & ARB (egg-yolk macula, bilateral depressed EOG Arden ratio <1.5 even in unilateral fundus presentations); and PIEZO2 LoF proprioception/vibration/bladder-stretch absence (Chesler & Bönnemann NEJM 2016) against GoF Distal Arthrogryposis Type 5 / Marden-Walker Syndrome. Walks at 1 Å inside verified PDBs 4HKR, 2ZW3, 7USW, 6N26, 8EV8, and 6KG7; includes two spoken calculation pauses (~20 fS single-channel Orai1 conductance & 5,000-10,000 channel STIM1 puncta NFAT accumulation; +80 mV endocochlear potential & 150 mV TMC1 driving force conducting 15,000x faster than Orai1); and integrates verified ClinicalTrials.gov trials (NCT02610582, NCT03758404, NCT03001310, NCT02599922, NCT02935517, NCT03278873, NCT04124185, NCT01648452, NCT07941115 SENS-601, NCT07627971 SKY-GJB2, NCT05402813, NCT05788536 DB-OTO, NCT05821959 AK-OTOF, NCT06370351 SENS-501, NCT03401190, NCT04681066 CARPO, NCT04345614 CARDEA, NCT06374797 KOURAGE).

item.title: When the Heart Forgets How to Reset: Congenital Long QT Syndrome (LQT1, LQT2, LQT3 & Jervell-Lange-Nielsen) — One-Ångström cryo-EM walks inside human KCNQ1-KCNE1-PIP2 (9VEC/9VEI), hERG (5VA1/7CN1), and NaV1.5 (6UZ3/7DTC), Bazett vs. Fridericia & late-I_NaL physics, nadolol, mexiletine in LQT2, lumacaftor-ivacaftor, and SupRep AAV9 gene therapy
item.description: Wave 10 Channelopathies Episode 1 (Ep 2661): Five-act One-Ångström-Tall Man medical and biophysical treatise on Congenital Long QT Syndrome (LQT1 KCNQ1/KCNE1, LQT2 KCNH2/hERG, LQT3 SCN5A) and Jervell-Lange-Nielsen deafness-QT syndrome, anchored to verified RCSB PDB structures 9VEC, 9VEI, 5VA1, 7CN1, 6UZ3 (+1 DI / +2 DIV rat offset), and 7DTC, two spoken worked calculation pauses (Bazett vs. Fridericia; late-I_NaL plateau charge transfer & Nernst E_K hypokalemia paradox), verified ClinicalTrials.gov trials (NCT04581408, NCT02365532, NCT02300558, NCT03291145, NCT02082431, NCT02814981, NCT03841838, NCT06546137), and emerging SupRep AAV9 gene therapy.

item.title: The Fever That Unmasks the Notch: Brugada Syndrome & SCN5A Overlap — Brugada Syndrome, Lenègre/PCCD & LQT3/BrS Overlap, Fever Q10 Unmasking, Ajmaline/Flecainide Provocation Bayesian PPV, Quinidine I_to Rescue & RVOT Epicardial Ablation (PDB 6UZ3, 6UZ0, 6LQA, 7DTC)
item.description: 5-Act One-Ångström-Tall Man Channelopathy Treatise covering nocturnal agonal respiration, Southeast Asian SUNDS/Lai Tai/Bangungut, high-precordial 2nd/3rd ICS ECG unmasking, Shanghai Score, Brugadadrugs.org hazards, Brugada phenocopies, Depolarization vs Repolarization mechanisms, cross-ancestry polygenic GWAS (Barc 2022, Ishikawa 2024), SCN5A overlap polarity (Lenègre/PCCD, E1784K, MEPPC G213D), 1-Å cryo-EM walk through PDB 6UZ3/6UZ0/6LQA/7DTC, Bayesian ajmaline PPV & fever Q10/I_to dome-collapse Calculation Pauses, ICD stratification, oral hydroquinidine, epicardial RVOT ablation (NCT02641431, BRAVO NCT04420078), and emerging Kv4.3/MOG1/Empagliflozin (NCT07146880) frontiers.

item.title: The Double-Barreled Chloride Shunt: Myotonia Congenita — CLCN1 Thomsen AD vs. Becker AR, Double-Barreled ClC-1 Gate, T-Tubule Potassium Trapping, Fournier Pattern II EMG, Mexiletine vs. Lamotrigine, and One Medicine Tennessee Fainting Goats (PDB 6COY, 6QVU)
item.description: One-Ångström-Tall Man Channelopathy Treatise (Ep 2664): Five-act bedside-to-cryo-EM deep dive into CLCN1 Myotonia Congenita (dominant Thomsen AD vs. recessive Becker AR), One Medicine Tennessee myotonic goats (p.Ala885Pro) & miniature Schnauzers, human ClC-1 cryo-EM structures PDB 6COY (3.36 Å) & PDB 6QVU (4.2 Å, low pH + CBS domains), two worked calculation pauses (30-nm T-tubule K+ trapping/GHK depolarization and dimer binomial dominant-negative probability), Fournier Pattern II vs. I/III EMG, perioperative succinylcholine safety, mexiletine (Statland/Stunnenberg/MYOMEX) vs. lamotrigine (Andersen), and future ClC-1 allosteric potentiators & RNA-seq splice diagnostics.

item.title: The Leak Through the Voltage Sensor: Periodic Paralyses & Paramyotonia Congenita — HypoPP (CACNA1S/SCN4A), HyperPP, Paramyotonia Congenita & the S4 Gating-Pore Omega (ω) Current Revolution (PDB 6AGF, 6JPA, 6C1K)
item.description: One-Ångström-Tall Man Channelopathy Treatise (Ep 2665 / CHAN_05): Contrasts HypoPP1 (CACNA1S R528H/R1239H) & HypoPP2 (SCN4A R669H/R672H/G/S) resting S4 gating-pore omega currents against HyperPP (SCN4A T704M/M1592V persistent I_NaP), cold-aggravated Eulenburg Paramyotonia Congenita (SCN4A R1448C/H), equine HYPP (Impressive Phe1416Leu), and Thyrotoxic PP (KCNJ18/Kir2.6). Walks at 1 Å through human NaV1.4-β1 (PDB 6AGF), CaV1.1-verapamil (PDB 6JPA), and NavAb(R2G)-guanidinium (PDB 6C1K); includes two spoken calculation pauses (paradoxical low-K+ Kir2.1 bistable depolarization & McManis LET peak-to-nadir CMAP decrement) and verified trial evidence (NCT00004802, HYP-HOP/Sansone 2021, Ciafaloni 2019, NCT02582476 bumetanide, NCT05639257 lamotrigine vs Namuscla, NCT06917430 AI muscle MRI).

item.title: Two Gates on One Muscle Fiber: Slow vs. Fast CMS & RYR1 Core Myopathies — Slow-Channel vs. Fast-Channel nAChR Kinetic Polarity, Double-CMAP & Pyridostigmine Contraindication Minefield (SCCMS, COLQ, DOK7), Fluoxetine/Quinidine Open-Channel Block, 3,4-DAP, Oral Salbutamol Fold Remodeling, Fetal Gamma-to-Epsilon Switch & Congenital RYR1 Core Myopathies vs. Malignant Hyperthermia With Cooperative ARM210/ATP Rycal Stabilization (PDB 9DMG, 9DMH, 7TZC)
item.description: 5-Act One-Ångström-Tall Man Channelopathy Treatise uniting Gate One (human adult muscle nAChR α2βδε in apo PDB 9DMG [2.05 Å] and ACh-bound PDB 9DMH [2.06 Å], Li et al., Cell 2025, PMID 40203823) and Gate Two (2.2-MDa RyR1–calstabin1–CaM–ARM210–ATP–caffeine–Ca2+–Zn2+ complex PDB 7TZC [2.45 Å], Melville et al., Structure 2022, PMID 35580609). Covers three bedside clinical vignettes (SCCMS double-CMAP wrist-extensor drop worsened by pyridostigmine; FCCMS/CHRNE infantile apnea rescued by pyridostigmine + 3,4-DAP vs. COLQ and DOK7 paradoxically worsened by pyridostigmine; congenital RYR1 core myopathy vs. acute MH), historical giants (Engel, Sine, Beeson, Yamanashi, Shy & Magee, fetal γ→ε switch), exact measured 1-Å geometries (α1 TRP149 cation-π box, αGLY153–PRO197 1.75→2.40 Å Loop B–C spring, εPRO121 2.57 Å FCCMS wall, M2 9'-Leu LEU251 6.98→9.57 Å pore expansion, εLEU269 2.22→1.76 Å SCCMS latch, RyR1 RY1&2 KVR5306–ATP5305 2.97 Å cooperative Rycal pocket), two spoken calculation pauses (30x subsynaptic Ca2+ excitotoxicity in SCCMS + pyridostigmine; neuromuscular safety factor EPP/ΔV_thresh collapse in FCCMS vs. DOK7 during 3 Hz RNS), precision clinical-polarity pharmacology, and active trials (NCT04141670, NCT07560020 Surlorian/ARM210, NCT06436742 ARGX-119, NCT07830563 AMP-101 AAV-DOK7, NCT02562066 amifampridine).

item.title: The Fracture the Scan Didn't Predict — Alendronate Hydroxyapatite Binding & Osteoclast FPPS Inhibition (PDB 2F92), FIT Hip Fracture Reduction, CTX/P1NP Turnover Markers & Atypical Subtrochanteric Femoral Fracture
item.description: Behind the Curtain Pharmacology Pilot 117: Alendronate Hydroxyapatite Binding & Osteoclast FPPS Inhibition (PDB 2F92), FIT Hip Fracture Reduction, CTX/P1NP Turnover Markers & Atypical Subtrochanteric Femoral Fracture. A woman’s hip density improved during alendronate treatment. Seven years after she started, a new ache down the outside of her thigh brings her back. Follow the separate paths from a whole-region density measurement to a focal cortical injury, and from an oral tablet to a mineral surface and an enzyme inside an osteoclast. The starting chapter, *Bone and Joints* in the 2013 third edition of *Haschek and Rousseaux’s Handbook of Toxicologic Pathology*, includes alendronate in an ovariectomized rat model and discusses bone remodeling, markers and atypical fractures. Use the animal material for mechanism and the linked human sources for clinical outcomes. Pharmacology notebook

item.title: The Ovulation Signal and the Outcome — Enclomiphene vs. Zuclomiphene Isomer Kinetics, Estrogen Receptor Antagonist Conformation (PDB 6VPF), Timed Mid-Luteal Progesterone vs. PPCOS II Live-Birth Endpoints
item.description: Behind the Curtain Pharmacology Pilot 118: Enclomiphene vs. Zuclomiphene Isomer Kinetics, Estrogen Receptor Antagonist Conformation (PDB 6VPF), Timed Mid-Luteal Progesterone vs. PPCOS II Live-Birth Endpoints. A follicle grows, the next scan shows it has collapsed, and progesterone rises. The Critical Care Clinician follows what each measurement establishes for a woman seeking pregnancy. The Molecular Pharmacologist follows clomiphene from a Merrell patent to an estrogen-receptor crystal and two distinct concentration curves. The patient, dates and dialogue are fictional. The Pharmacology notebook’s *Volume II: Sports Pharmacology, Ergogenics and Metabolic Modulators*, dossier 2.1, supplies the starting reference to clomiphene as a hormonal-axis drug. The fertility episode draws on separate evidence in women. Historical sources use polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS). The international guideline adopted polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome (PMOS) in its May 2026 terminology update. Pharmacology notebook · International guideline terminology update

item.title: The Drug That Had to Reach the Colon — Azad Khan's 1977 Sulfasalazine Split Experiment, pH-Dependent Eudragit & MMX Mesalamine Colonic Delivery, Fecal Calprotectin vs. Mucosal Endoscopy & Interstitial Nephritis Surveillance
item.description: Behind the Curtain Pharmacology Pilot 120: Azad Khan's 1977 Sulfasalazine Split Experiment, pH-Dependent Eudragit & MMX Mesalamine Colonic Delivery, Fecal Calprotectin vs. Mucosal Endoscopy & Interstitial Nephritis Surveillance. An oral drug can reach the bloodstream and still deliver little to the tissue it is meant to treat. Mesalamine turns that problem into a historical experiment. First separate the two products of sulfasalazine, then find a way to bring the active one back to inflamed colonic mucosa. The starting source is Chapter Four, *Mucosal Healing in Ulcerative Colitis: Pathophysiology and Pharmacology*, in *Advances in Clinical Chemistry* (2013). Its discussion of 5-aminosalicylic acid and epithelial restitution leads into the original experiments. Pharmacology notebook

item.title: The Second Peak in the Blood — Mycophenolic Acid Uncompetitive Human IMPDH2 Trapping (PDB 1JR1), Acyl-MPAG Immunoassay Cross-Reactivity vs. LC–MS/MS & Enterohepatic Recirculation Second Peak
item.description: Behind the Curtain Pharmacology Pilot 106: Mycophenolic Acid Uncompetitive Human IMPDH2 Trapping (PDB 1JR1), Acyl-MPAG Immunoassay Cross-Reactivity vs. LC–MS/MS & Enterohepatic Recirculation Second Peak. An afternoon draw brings a second puzzle. The active drug is rising again, hours after the morning tablet. The Critical Care Clinician follows competing causes of the symptoms. The Molecular Pharmacologist follows the ester, the active acid, and two glucuronides through the enzyme pocket, intestine and assays. The case, numerical timeline and dialogue are fictional.
